messages:
Maria Chen: quick q — thinking about a lightweight "alert-wrangler sidecar" in the console that surfaces per-route SLO rules, why a page DID/ DID NOT page (suppression reason), and estimated fanout. Would help PMs & oncall debug noisy rules. thoughts?

Arjun Patel: sounds useful. short-term: prefer a read-only panel that explains decision graph (rule matched -> suppression -> routing). gotta watch perf and secrets.

Luis Gomez: +1. For noise debugging we should include a 7d violation sample and suppression reason. also show the active routing tier and which fallback would be used.

Priya Rao: UX preference: inline compact panel on the SLO card that expands to a timeline. modal is heavy. CTA: "Explain last action".

Maria Chen: prototype fields I imagine: current threshold, last violation ts, suppression reason (quiet-window / dedupe / manual), active routing tier, est_fanout, and a small telemetry sparkline. lazy-load details. example API sketch:

```http
GET /internal/api/v1/alert-wrangler?route_id=rt_12345
200 OK
{
  "slo_current": "99.92%",
  "violation_at": "2025-02-18T15:12:00Z",
  "suppressed_by": "quiet-window(tenant:acct_9)",
  "active_tier": "tier-reserved",
  "est_fanout": 8
}
```

Arjun Patel: backend notes: we can synthesize from metrics + notify state store. big concern is page-load cost if we resolve for all routes shown. propose: show cached summary for the list, lazy-load full explanation on expand. cache TTL maybe 2m.

Luis Gomez: telemetry: avoid scanning raw events on expand. use pre-aggregated violation_summary table (per-route, per-1m bucket). also attach token-cost estimate for estimated fanout.

Priya Rao: rollout approach: internal-only first (redwood@), gate by tenant-count on page (<1000 routes), enable an "explain" link for oncall. design will show compact + expand.

deploy-bot: rollout job created: rollout/alert-wrangler-internal -> canary 10% -> scheduled 1745502500

Maria Chen: action items: Arjun prototype API + cache, Luis add violation_summary view & cost calc, Priya mock compact panel, I'll draft privacy + compliance checklist. if opt-out required, mark on checklist.

Arjun Patel: starting branch now, will spike API + caching. ETA end of week. :rocket:

Luis Gomez: note: add tenant opt-out flag in config (compliance request). putting in backlog item.

Priya Rao: I'll upload initial mocks tomorrow.

deploy-bot: rollout canary started at 1745502520.

Maria Chen: great — keeping scope tight for canary. ping if any blockers.

Arjun Patel: ack. will ping if latency budget becomes an issue.

Luis Gomez: ack, will prototype aggregator query and share perf numbers.

Priya Rao: ack.
